description_en: Queries a list of user groups on a bastion host
description_zh: 获取指定堡垒机下的用户组列表
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-user-groups --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --user-group-name TestGroup01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListUserGroups

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the bastion host on which you want to query user groups.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances ](~~462953~~)operation to query the ID of the bastion host.
parameters.description_zh:
指定要查询用户组列表的堡垒机实例ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host on which you want to query user groups.

> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数

parameters.description_en:
The region ID of the bastion host on which you want to query user groups.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~462924~~).
parameters.description_zh:
指定要查询用户组列表的堡垒机的区域ID。
> 区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。

parameters.description_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1.
parameters.description_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为**1**。
parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为**1**
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.description_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned on each page.
parameters.description_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
> 建议PageSize取值不要为空。
